notes: 100px circle: whole pie in ms-bgColor-neutralLight with a blue #0078d4 SVG wedge starting at 12 o'clock sweeping clockwise by the fraction (arc geometry must match — large-arc flag flips past 50%), and the percentage label ('77%' etc., value * 100) overlaid in the lower half in neutralPrimary light-weight xl text. Values are fractions 0..1; screenshot shows 77%, 33%, 16%, 45%.

attributes.d: ='M50,50 L50,0, A50,50 0 ' + if(@currentField <= 0.5, '0', '1') + ',1 ' + toString(50 + (sin(6.2831853 * if(@currentField >= 1, 0.9999, if(@currentField < 0, 0, @currentField))) * 50)) + ',' + toString(50 - (cos(6.2831853 * if(@currentField >= 1, 0.9999, if(@currentField < 0, 0, @currentField))) * 50)) + ' z'
